verify_first.body: Still the SIC-combination question — whether Endeavor's asterisk rule lets your military SIC time count toward PIC / PIC Cross Country / PIC Night. resolving_naturally.body: Big one: the Instrument-Airplane checkride passed 8/24 — that rating is done, not just 'in hand' anymore. highest_leverage.body: Pace has picked back up: 10.1 hrs added in the 11 days since the last review (~28 hrs/month), still well off the ~70 hrs/month checkride-prep sprint but no longer flat. At 566.2/750 (75%) with 183.8 hrs left, keeping a steady cadence through the rest of Commercial ME and into CFI is what actually moves this number, not any single metric here.

lagging.label: Lagging without a natural fix
lagging.body: PIC Night: 1.6/25 (6%) — still completely untouched, including by both of the newest flights. This remains the one category that needs deliberate scheduling — a few dedicated night legs, flown as PIC, are the only thing that moves it.
